title: JOHNNY APPLESEED BACKSCATTER — full circumnavigate. US seats ? 400y curves ? world bounce.
fuse: apple -=+ seed ? appleSeed. walker plants priors; echo returns as rates ±error.

do_not_reinvent.walkers: walker-taxonomy-sort / t-plane self?out — already sort walkers by distance_inside
do_not_reinvent.yellowstone: yellowstone-baseline — hold curves up to a known basin before crowning

seat_the_US.ORDER: nominal set — all states, all cities that file or should file. totality first. no danger medals until shared completeness.

cities.scope: every incorporated place that can appear on a UCR / NIBRS / local year-end table
cities.refuse: do not rank cities against each other until tags match

seat_the_US.compare_to: actual rates when owned counts exist; else hold as inferred with wide error

violation_curves_400y.window: ~1620s ? now (~400 years on this continent's colonial?present spine; Europe longer)
violation_curves_400y.what_we_compare: today's US city/state seats held against long-curve PRIOR baselines — not against yesterday's headline rank

baselines_not_certainties.curve: Eisner / Western Europe homicide secular decline
baselines_not_certainties.shape: medieval tens?seventies per 100k ? modern ~1 per 100k (factor ~10–50× down by 20th c.)
baselines_not_certainties.cite: Eisner long-term homicide; Our World in Data summary
baselines_not_certainties.error: court records ? police UCR. definition drift. elite vs street homicide mix shifts.

baselines_not_certainties.shape: early 1600s often >100 / 100k ? ~1–5 / 100k by ~1790 in studied colonies
baselines_not_certainties.cite: Roth American Homicide; National Academies summary
baselines_not_certainties.error: colony samples, race/status filters, sparse years — prior with fat tails

baselines_not_certainties.cite: Our World in Data / WHO mortality
baselines_not_certainties.error: national aggregates hide city reporting asymmetry (Lansing lesson)

violation_curves_400y.rule: curve is a PRIOR you refire toward. actual rate seats on top with ±error. violation = distance from seated prior, not from a medal.

world_bounce.do: circumnavigate — bounce the same method around the world

rings.seed: WHO / UNODC / local statistical offices — tag inferred heavily
backscatter returns to Lansing seat with global prior updated

world_bounce.not: one world danger ranking. that is null-kind waste.

johnny_appleseed_walkers.who: walkers who plant reporting orchards — priors, completeness flags, error bars — as they go
johnny_appleseed_walkers.myth: Johnny Appleseed did not crown orchards by sweetness rank. he walked, planted, moved. fruit came later.
method: arrive at a seat (state / city / country)
plant a prior baseline (curve + completeness prior)
listen for backscatter (agency counts, year-end, silence)
walk on — leave the orchard for the next walker
full circumnavigate: when the path closes, the mesh has seeds everywhere, not medals

full_circumnavigate_backscatter.path: Lansing ? US seats ? oceans ? world rings ? home locus
full_circumnavigate_backscatter.echo: each plant returns a rate±error or a silent gap. silence is data (wide prior).
full_circumnavigate_backscatter.totality: the orchard is the ORDER. fruit ripeness is local. never one global gold medal.

pipeline: seat all US states + cities (nominal ORDER + tags)
load ~400y violation / homicide curve priors (Eisner, Roth, OWID) with fat error
compare actual owned rates to priors — distance = work surface
berry_at_the_fire: yes — all states and cities in the US first, as seats not medals. hold them against actual rates and the ~400-year violation curves. bounce around the world. Johnny Appleseed walkers: full circumnavigate backscatter. plant priors, listen for echo, work the error. never CERTAINTY.
next: walker pass can fill seats incrementally. start completeness tags on MI peers, then ring out. no full fake table — orchards grow.
